* Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to translate business processes into scalable, automated solutions

* Complex validations
* Calculations and derived fields
* Conditional routing
* Data transformation logic
* Maintain clean, reusable logic patterns without overengineering or heavy custom code.

* Configure and validate integrations between Government App Builder and external systems (e.g., ERP, financial systems).
* Support API\-based, file\-based, event\-based or scheduled data exchange patterns.
* Design field mappings and transformation logic to ensure data consistency across systems.
* Document integration patterns and reusable configuration standards.

* Partner with Project Managers and Implementation Consultants to deliver configured solutions on time and within scope.

* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to Customer Success teams.

* Strong analytical thinking with systems and process\-improvement mindset.

* Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer\-facing implementation roles.
* Familiarity with security concepts such as role\-based access control and data governance practices.

You will help modernize government operations by designing configurable, scalable applications that replace spreadsheets, manual workflows, and disconnected systems. As part of our Professional Services team, you will:

* Shape best practices for Government App Builder implementations.
